Trader-Friendly Volatility Ranking

Score direction (intuitive): low score = low volatility, high score = high volatility, on a 0-100 scale. Deterministic Vol Score is the deterministic anchor: percentile blend of realized vol, beta, and max drawdown. RLCD1/2/3 are model scores normalized onto the same scale. Consensus Vol is their mean. History: ⚠ Thin = fewer than 200 trading days of price data.

Methodology

  • Deterministic Vol Score (deterministic anchor): equal-weight percentile rank of annualized daily vol, beta, and max drawdown across the universe.
  • Model normalization: raw model score -> cross-sectional percentile -> flip so higher = more volatile -> clip to [0, 100]. Every model passes through the identical pipeline, so scores are directly comparable run-to-run. Tickers with no quantitative anchor (recent IPOs) show the model percentile alone.
  • Returns are logarithmic, annualized with sqrt(252/52/12).
